sentence: A night street race: three laps against two rivals, nitro on a pad, the walls break
title: Night street race

brief.rules: Three cars race three laps of a closed street loop through checkpoints. The first car over the line after its third lap wins. A nitro pad on the main straight gives a short burst of speed. Wall segments at two corners break when a car hits them hard and leave rubble on the road.
brief.arena: A city block at night: a road loop with a long straight, a chicane and two tight corners, lined with breakable barrier walls, street lamps and lit shop fronts.
brief.ai: Two rival cars follow the racing line through the checkpoints, brake for corners, use the nitro pad when they cross it and steer around rubble.
brief.controls: The player drives one car: W accelerates, S brakes and reverses, A and D steer.
brief.mood: Wet dark asphalt, neon signs and warm lamp pools, three cars in strong colours with bright tail lights.
